content: Use fireworks only according to the manufacturer's instructions and applicable local regulations.
Children should use fireworks only with appropriate adult supervision.
Use fireworks only in suitable open outdoor areas and maintain the safety distance specified by the manufacturer.
Keep fireworks away from heat, flames, moisture and other flammable materials. Store in a cool, dry place away from children.
Light one firework at a time and step back immediately. Keep a bucket of water or sand ready nearby.
Wear cotton clothing and closed footwear while lighting. Do not wear loose or synthetic clothes.
Do not try to relight a firework that failed to go off.
Do not light fireworks indoors or near buildings and vehicles.
